'''Ferentina''' was a [[City/Legends|town]] founded on the banks of the [[Andrevea River]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. The town was located in a [[Mountain/Legends|mountain]] pass and on a road which branched out from a tunnel that it passed through. A [[Security hangar|security]] [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]], capable of holding a variety of vehicles, was also situated on the banks. [[Devils tower]], a mysterious landmark, could be found nearby in the canyon. The town was destroyed by [[Trade Federation droid bomber]]s during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]]. [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Gavyn Sykes/Legends|Gavyn Sykes]] of the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]] was in the area during the attack.

==Description==
Ferentina lay on one side of the [[Andrevea River]], and a wall was built up to block off the [[river]]. The town sat on two levels of a hill<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" /> and was located in a mountain pass.<ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|I|264|Ferentina}}</ref> Nearby was a [[bridge]] over the Andrevea River, and a road passed over the bridge to come out of a nearby tunnel and branch through the town. Many residential buildings were scattered throughout the town, and there was a central plaza with a clock tower. A [[Security hangar|security]] [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]], capable of holding [[Water/Legends|aquatic]], land, and air vehicles was also situated on the banks of the river. A canyon passage nearby led northward to [[Devils tower]]&mdash;a mysterious landmark&mdash;and other ancient ruins.<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" />

==History==
[[File:BFN_DestroyedFerentina.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The town is destroyed by the Trade Federation forces.]]
During the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] in the year [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="The New Essential Chronology" /> the [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|Trade Federation Droid Army]] attacked and destroyed Ferentina, which was serving as a refugee camp for [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo civilians]]. Two [[Seraph-class urban landspeeder|''Seraph''-class urban landspeeders]] in the town became stuck behind a fallen tower. At the time of the attack, [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Gavyn Sykes/Legends|Gavyn Sykes]] of the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]] was traveling in a [[Ostracoda-class gunboat|captured Federation gunboat]] and leading a convoy of civilians he had [[Liberation of enslavement camps|rescued]] from the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]]. The convoy became trapped near Ferentina when the bridge over the river was [[Proton bomb/Legends|bombed]]. Sykes and the convoy entered the security hangar to switch vehicles.<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: Episode I: Battle for Naboo}}
Sykes then rescued the two trapped speeders from behind the tower, and he escorted the convoy survivors to a hidden location in the nearby mountain pass.<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Ferentina appears during a mission of the [[2000]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Episode I: Battle for Naboo]]''.<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" /> If all the houseboats or speeders get destroyed, the mission fails. Two speeders are trapped behind a fallen tower in the mission, and the player has the option of rescuing them. The rescue is not necessary to win, but it is required for the "friendlies saved" score. This article assumes the player intervenes.<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" />
